investigation.key_fact: service recommendation (internalTrafficPolicy=Local) has ready endpoints only on kind-worker; client deployment/frontend runs on kind-worker2, where calls to recommendation find no local endpoint

arms.text:
Root cause: service `recommendation` in namespace `astronomy-shop`.
Mechanism: service recommendation (internalTrafficPolicy=Local) has ready endpoints only on kind-worker; client deployment/frontend runs on kind-worker2, where calls to recommendation find no local endpoint.
How it fails: service recommendation was changed recently and breaks deployment/recommendation, which it acts on.
Concrete details: service recommendation fields written: spec.internalTrafficPolicy; service recommendation has internalTrafficPolicy=Local: only endpoints on the client's own node receive traffic; service recommendation (internalTrafficPolicy=Local) has ready endpoints only on kind-worker; client deployment/frontend runs on kind-worker2, where calls to recommendation find no local endpoint; Service recommendation was modified 193s ago, 69s after it was created (fields: spec.internalTrafficPolicy); 65s before the first active symptom.
Observed impact: deployment `recommendation` in namespace `astronomy-shop`.
Fault type: traffic policy (a Service traffic policy leaves some clients without a reachable endpoint).
Evidence:
- service recommendation fields written: spec.internalTrafficPolicy
- service recommendation has internalTrafficPolicy=Local: only endpoints on the client's own node receive traffic
- service recommendation (internalTrafficPolicy=Local) has ready endpoints only on kind-worker; client deployment/frontend runs on kind-worker2, where calls to recommendation find no local endpoint
- Service recommendation was modified 193s ago, 69s after it was created (fields: spec.internalTrafficPolicy); 65s before the first active symptom
- deployment/recommendation: service recommendation has internalTrafficPolicy=Local: only endpoints on the client's own node receive traffic
